name: BMF Player Sync
description: Feeds Omegga player identity records into the Brickadia Modding Framework player cache.
author: BMF

commandDir.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime/commands. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_COMMAND_DIR or OMEGGA_BMF_RUNTIME_DIR is used.

syncDelayMs.description: Debounce delay before writing a sync request after player list changes.

syncIntervalMs.description: Periodic fallback sync interval. Set to 0 to disable polling and rely only on Omegga join/leave/start/manual events.

brickadiaLogPath.description: Optional explicit Brickadia.log path used when Omegga's live player list is empty.

forwardInteract.description: Forward Omegga interact events into BMF as bmf.interact.console commands. This is game-thread sensitive and should stay disabled unless a BMF Lua handler explicitly needs it. OMEGGA_BMF_FORWARD_INTERACT overrides this value.

interactCommand.description: BMF command used for forwarded interact messages.
